intro: GreenTree does not publish a rate card, and we would rather explain why than print a number we cannot stand behind. No two commercial properties price the same way — turf area, plant material, access, irrigation zones and service frequency all move the figure, and a contractor who quotes before walking the site is either guessing or leaving room to rebuild the price in change orders later. We walk the property first, then give you a written scope and one number against it.

cost_table.heading: What a maintenance proposal is priced on
cost_table.lede: These are the factors that actually move the number on a commercial landscape maintenance contract in South Florida.
rows: Open lawn mows fast; narrow islands, slopes, bollards and parked-car obstacles do not. Access dictates equipment, and equipment dictates crew hours.
Growing season in South Florida is long. Weekly, fortnightly and seasonal-adjusted schedules produce materially different annual figures.
Hedges, ornamentals and seasonal colour need pruning cycles and hand weeding. Beds are usually the difference between two properties with identical lawn area.
The number of zones sets how long a scheduled inspection takes. Repairs are quoted separately, so the inspection cost stays predictable.
Integrated Pest Management is diagnosis-led. A property with chronic chinch bug or fungal pressure needs a different programme than one without.
Palm fronds, storm litter and heavy seasonal drop all carry haul-away cost that varies by property and time of year.
cost_table.footnote: Planting, seasonal colour changes and irrigation repairs are quoted as separate line items rather than folded into the maintenance figure, so you can see what you are approving.

notes: GreenTree serves commercial clients only. If you are looking for residential lawn care, we are not the right fit and will say so on the first call.
